productMeta.note: V47: durable feed inventory + checkpoints + continuation ledger; presentation budget rotates and is not an API source cap.

continuationLedger.note: Continuation proof across durable checkpoints. Declared feed metadata counts are not loaded products. Presentation budget ≠ API source cap.

productProgressLedger.note: withFeedTracked = inventory hasFeed only. productProgress excludes 1→1/0→0 and empty-API completePass bumps. Cursor advance without rows is CURSOR_ADVANCED, not product progress.

refreshMeta.note: V37: documented shoppingProducts(productIds) targeted refresh; miss ≠ deleted; does not advance discovery checkpoints.

coverage.honestNote: successfullyRefreshed counts only productId matches from shoppingProducts(productIds); miss is not treated as deleted.

capacity.caveat: V37 productIds mode uses documented shoppingProducts(productIds) filter. Miss ≠ deleted without stronger evidence. Capacity is advertiser/batch based, not catalog-depth scan.

coverageSummary.honestNote: successfullyRefreshed counts only productId matches from shoppingProducts(productIds); miss is not treated as deleted.

lastPass.note: Measured pass only — not a simulation or capacity estimate.

rootCauseV37.priorLowCoverage: Scan-window refresh (pageSize×maxPages≈500) against deep catalogs (e.g. totalCount 82k) + refresh checkpoint not restored between runs (always startedOffset=1).
rootCauseV37.fix: Documented shoppingProducts(productIds) targeted refresh + durable refresh-coverage checkpoint restore/persist.

coverageReconcile.note: sourceMatched=raw productIds first-pass; successfullyRefreshed includes V38 recoveries; cumulative updated post-reverify.

formatOnly.note: Format-only diagnostic history is intentionally capped (default MAX_FMT=1000). retainedOut is documented rolling retention, NOT economic price-history loss. archivedStatus remains NOT_ARCHIVED unless a separate archive writer exists.
